title: specs/<feature>/verification.yaml — requirement→verifier evidence graph
description: Contract for the traceability artifact introduced by #190 §3 (increment B, #193). The artifact is YAML on disk in a deliberately CONSTRAINED two-level shape so shell tooling can parse it without a YAML library; this schema describes that shape and is the authoritative contract — scripts/lib/verification-common.sh is the enforcement. Workflow: scripts/generate-verification-draft.sh emits status: draft with placeholder verifiers; the AUTHOR reviews, fills real verifiers, and flips status to finalized; validate-spec.sh --unattended validates at admission and never authors. spec.md is the only authoritative source of requirement text: statement is generated display text, statement_sha binds it to the normalized FR-N text (sha256 over 'FR-N: <normalized statement>'), and admission recomputes every hash, failing on any mismatch. Increment B admits only kind: deterministic verifiers; kind: runtime_conformance is schema-valid but INADMISSIBLE until the #190 §6 evaluator ships in increment C (a verifier something depends on cannot be unavailable). LAYOUT IS PART OF THE CONTRACT: the shell parser accepts exactly the generator's emitted indentation — top-level 'FR-N:' keys, two-space entry fields, 'verifiers:' items as four-space '- kind:' with six-space value keys. Regenerate from the draft generator rather than hand-reflowing; other YAML layouts are schema-valid YAML but fail admission closed (zero parsed verifiers).

status.description: draft = generator output, inadmissible by definition; finalized = author-reviewed. Admission requires finalized.

statement.description: Generated display text — never authoritative; spec.md is.

test.description: Executable target: a path relative to the project root, or a command resolvable on PATH. Placeholder TODO values fail admission.

criterion.description: Concrete runtime criterion. Requires the #190 §6 evaluator (increment C) — inadmissible in increment B.
